measurement.tracked: Git index blob logical bytes at supplied base; protected names excluded before blob metadata
measurement.localVisible: Nontracked regular files physically visible inside repository, including ignored files; no .git, junction traversal, protected paths or Task221 self-outputs
measurement.units: bytes; logical sizes, not filesystem allocation or Git pack size
measurement.activeRuntime: tracked and local statically traced artifact envelopes; conservative upper bound, not code/dependency installation size
measurement.reclaim: potential logical bytes; no deletion; archive depends on reference migration; duplicate rows not added to reclaim

existingHashDuplicates.basis: existing Git blob object IDs only; no new hashing; not physically reclaimable Git storage estimate

coordination.synchronization: Explicit Work decision accepts Task220 only; prior stale coordination blocker resolved; unrelated blockers preserved.
